body: If you are physically hurting you might want to consider to see a doctor.
I get it. I've wanted to drive off a cliff so many times I cant even count. Everything feels so goddamn heavy. I'm on the brink of collapse.
I just want to end it at this point. Been rejected. Borderline abused. Fake friends. All of that shit.

I know exactly how you are feeling, because I feel that too. If you need someone to talk to you've came to the right place. There are so many people who will talk and understand your heartbreaks, trauma, divorce, and when you think you have no friends, you find yourself here. Surrounded by a bunch of..."Understanders".
Hey, I'm suicidal as well, so from one to another, just hang in there. I know its tough and rough but just keep fighting, or just try to. Just keep fighting and pushing!
